text_block_list.text:
Stopping by the cafeteria―― I spotted a 
group gathered around a table scattered 
with coins, completely absorbed in a game.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—C'mon, bet everything you've got on hand. 
Let's make this a real nail-biter, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa, run for it—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, after all the effort to set the 
stage, it's completely ruined.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, wrong. I was just playing pretend 
with some chocolate coins.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In this academy, is playing a harmless 
game with snacks against the rules too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "But" nothing. ...Sit down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Consider it an apology... Play a round 
with me. —Draw poker, that is.

And just like that, a game of poker began 
against an Umamusume with a terrifyingly 
fierce glare.
(Swish swish swish――)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, that look on your face. Seems you 
were dealt a winning hand right from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However... which hand is truly superior? 
Take a closer look and compare.

With those words, Nakayama Festa proceeded 
to flip her cards over, one by one from 
the edge!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If the last card is a "7", that's a 
straight. It's a strong hand, but what'll 
you do?

My hand is three of a kind. If she really 
has a straight, I'll lose, but――
choice_data_list:
That's dangerous... Let's back down from 
this challenge for now.
It's a bluff... I'm betting all my coins!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, boring. The type to hold back 
reserves instead of going for broke, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, just for this once, it turned out to 
be a good call.

With those words, she revealed her final 
card. The 7 of Hearts—that was a close 
one...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Narrow escape. But are you satisfied just 
cutting your losses? Get serious. Let's 
make this... a contest right on the edge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
――Oho, going all-in with suicidal resolve, 
are we? That is nothing short of 
self-destruction...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Only those willing to plunge straight into 
the jaws of death can seize true 
victory...

With those words, she revealed her final 
card. The 4 of Clubs. The wager was won—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that was time well spent. Who knew 
there was a bird of the same feather here 
at this academy.
